documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Ram Ratna Wires Limited presented its investor presentation for Q2 & H1 FY27, outlining financial performance and strategic expansion across its Winding Wires & Strips and Copper Tubes & Pipes platforms. The company reported revenue from operations of ₹2,145.9 Cr and Operating EBITDA of ₹179.1 Cr for H1 FY27. It announced a proposed acquisition of EPACK's 50% stake in EPAVO Electricals for ₹15 Cr to turn it into a 100% subsidiary. Additionally, subsidiary Tefabo is undertaking a phased expansion in Vadodara to double its wind turbine tower capacity. Ram Ratna Wires Limited reported its financial results and operational updates for Q1 FY27, showing growth in revenue and profitability alongside ongoing capacity expansions and strategic segment diversifications.

demand_outlook.claim: India currently relies on imports for approximately 70% of its copper tube demand.
demand_outlook.quote: India imports roughly 70% of its copper tubes — five advantages position Ram Ratna to substitute them

Operating EBITDA for Q4 FY26 reached INR 93.2 crores with an EBITDA margin of 5.3%.

orders_capacity.quote: 30 lakh motors/annum installed; >90% localisation in HVLS PMSM motors.

orders_capacity.claim: The Bhiwadi facility is one of India's largest copper tube plants with inner grooved tube capabilities.

orders_capacity.claim: The Tefabo facility in Bangalore, Karnataka has a current capacity of approximately 40 towers per month.
